title: Vintage Woman Grid Study

prompt: A woman with short brown hair wearing a long orange dress with blue floral patterns, white gloves, and carrying a brown handbag, shown in a 4x4 grid of different standing poses including front, three-quarter, side, and back views. She has a neutral expression and stands on a flat surface with soft shadows against a light blue background with floating transparent bubbles, consistent lighting and style across all 16 figures, clean studio presentation
